content:
The minimum possible number of ten-ruble heads-up coins occurs when as many heads-up coins as possible are five-ruble coins.

There are 7 five-ruble coins, so at most 7 heads-up coins can be five-ruble. Thus the minimum number of ten-ruble heads-up coins is

\[
x_{\min}=20-7=13.
\]

So there can be as few as 13 ten-ruble heads-up coins, meaning the other \(30-13=17\) coins are not ten-ruble heads-up. Therefore, any selection of \(17+1=18\) coins must include a ten-ruble heads-up coin.

\[
\boxed{18}
\]
